items.text: Your path: a Next card on Current shows one useful step at a time.
An audiobook brought in alone is named, and Needs you asks which book it is.
Settings say what each part does for you, and what it still needs.
The header's level reads as about how many words you know.
A removed title added again offers Put back or Add as new.
A failed Generate says why, with Generate again and Report a problem.
A rare crash just after a press is fixed.
A move saves at once, even while Surasura reads your library.
File pickers for shows and books open in your Videos folder.
The ⋯ menu opens faster at high scaling.
